svg.title: Same Instruction, Different User Personas: Personalized Robot Actions.
svg.desc: Conceptual workflow: two users provide profiles with personal background, living context, work, interests and habits, and give the identical instruction, Set up my desk for work. One personal robot policy reads the profile, instruction and scene, selects task-relevant cues from the broader profile, infers likely preferences, then plans and acts. The policy connects computer-based work and hand-use habits to this desk instruction; relevance is not marked in the input profile. The profiles do not provide a persona label, target mouse placement or explicit preference list. Hand use during writing and sketching provides an illustrative cue for likely mouse-side preference; it does not guarantee that preference. The inferred plan connects to the robot on each Before-to-After transition. Both before views reuse the same initial desk state; the keyboard, monitor and notebook stay fixed. The task persona setup goes only to evaluation, never to the policy inputs. This conceptual Task 1 mouse-placement example does not depict all task goals or a measured rollout result.
